# Navbar title and menu overlap due to undefined width CSS variable
Navbar.vue uses --sidebar-expanded-width, but that variable is only defined in the unloaded variables.scss, while the effective variables.css does not define it, causing long titles to overlap with the top menu.

## Root Cause
- Navbar.vue references --sidebar-expanded-width, but variables.css (the effective file) lacks this variable
- The variable is only defined in variables.scss, which is not loaded, leading to missing variable
- Long titles and top menu overlap due to failed width calculation

## Solution
- Add --sidebar-expanded-width: 288px to variables.css
- Unify --sidebar-width to 288px
- Add 288px fallback in Navbar.vue

# Vite proxy key missing leading slash causes proxy failure
Vite proxy match function uses req.url.startsWith(key), and when VITE_APP_BASE_API lacks leading slash the rule cannot match.

## Root Cause
- doesProxyContextMatchUrl uses req.url.startsWith(key) for matching
- req.url always starts with /
- When VITE_APP_BASE_API is api/v2.0 without leading /, context fails to match

## Solution
- Add normalizeProxyContext in vite.config.js to normalize context to /api/v2.0 to match request path

# Visible menu count must use .top-nav actual width excluding left padding
Visible menu count calculated by full .top-nav-container width miscounts 1~2 items, and nav-items-scroll overflow-x: auto makes clipped items still visible.

## Root Cause
- Visible menu count uses .top-nav-container full width (including 276px left padding) causing 1~2 extra items
- .nav-items-scroll sets overflow-x: auto making clipped items still visible and clickable

## Solution
- Calculate by .top-nav actual width and reserve 180px for "More"
- Change menu area to overflow: hidden
- Add ResizeObserver to recalc on width change, move overflow items into "More"
